title: I have been to... the mall? Wth I am stumped
content: Hi everyone, A couple weeks ago I had this weird dream that seemed too real. I wrote about it and posted on a couple forums. I was browsing some subs I like and then on one of the comments, a person mentioned this forum. Anyway, I will just paste what I have written.. I am so confused right now. " Hey guys, A couple of days ago, I had this weird dream, and I just kept thinking about it. Since I can not get it out of my mind, I decided to post it on some forums and see other people's opinions about it. When I came to my senses, I was inside a gallery / mall full of different stores, clothes stores, electronics, games stores, etc. It was night, and I was walking to a specific store in there. The feeling I had is that I had done something pretty bad, and I was hiding in there. After a while, I got bored and decided to walk around the gallery. Suddenly I started feeling scared and I saw this guy coming right around the corner, he saw me and then I just turned around and started running. He was able to intercept me later, and then I just looked at him and said: So, this is it? Ok, do what you gotta do. Then he raised a gun and shot right in my face. I fell down, everything went black and then I opened my eyes. It was all blurry, but I saw the guy walking away, and there was a lot of blood all over me, coming from the wound. It felt weird and warm. I sat down, tried to make sense of it all, and then I thought, 'ok, enough. I have to get out of here' and I woke up. And when I woke up, I thought I had had a brain aneurism or something because I was feeling extremely dizzy, my vision was blurry, I was feeling nauseous, and my head was feeling weird I was not in pain but I felt some tingling on the region I was shot and my ear was feeling warm so I started touching my head trying to find the hole but there was no hole and then I checked everything for blood but there was no blood. I got up, went to the living room, confused as hell, and just sat down on the couch for some minutes and my vision started to slowly come back and the weird sensation on my head started to fade away. Have you guys ever had or ever heard about any dream this vivid? " Please let me know what you guys know about this thing. Thank you,
